name: Verify controller metadata read installer live

on:
  push:
    branches: [fix/tm-read-latency-20261007]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/tm-controller-read-live.yml
      - scripts/verify-tm-read-live.mjs

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: tm-controller-read-live-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/fix/tm-read-latency-20261007'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Verify exact API and Worker installer bytes without production writes
        run: node scripts/verify-tm-read-live.mjs
      - name: Preserve bounded verification evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: tm-controller-read-live
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/tm-read-live.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
